scope: Complete bounded generated public Boolean systems only. No curve input, imported target, scalar recovery, production integration, IC or rho campaign.
fixtures: n+2 equations, twelve distinct quadratic monomials and up to four linear monomials per equation. Planted families choose constants to satisfy a public reproducible Boolean witness that is never passed to the solver. Cross-planted makes a pair differ by a valid affine consequence. Unplanted constants are independent; its status is established by complete search when available. No fixture screening.
ordering: Seven repetitions per fixture, first-arm offset 7*c modulo 32 for fixture index c. In each size cohort of 42 fixtures, each method occupies each position nine or ten times. This is near balance across a cohort, not exact balance within each fixture. Ratios pair identical fixture and repetition.
final_gate: Require every n16/20/24, family and regression/holdout group to have a paired 95 percent lower bound above 2.0 against the pointwise fastest fixed reference roster. All 18 groups and every 168-cell completion and verification must pass. Separate incremental >1.0 and matched-backend >1.05 thresholds cannot replace the dramatic gate. No tuning after holdout timing. Any eligible treatment requires unchanged timed-source confirmation on unused holdouts.
accounting: Cold totals include input encoding, graph construction, exact variable selection, coefficient-plan setup, Gray updates, every screen including failed screens, linear solving, recovery, destruction and validation. New phases selection_ns, fiber_setup_ns and fiber_ns are exclusive. Fiber prefixes and rejected extensions are distinct from evaluated full assignments. Filter rounds count each evaluated lane at every executed screen round; a four-lane group continues only while some lane survives. Matrix ranks are per-query ranks, not independent collected relations. Whole-worker RSS includes all arms; candidate-specific allocation and calibrated operation counts remain unmeasured.
correctness: Exact maximum independent variable set from the original quadratic interaction graph; every outside assignment leaves a linear system. Direct row elimination, compact column membership and native/scalar batched screens must agree on the smallest inside witness, original model, semantic work and trace. Redundant row maps are v XOR (v >> d), with fixed d=[1,2,3,4,5,7,8]. A zero coefficient row with RHS one is the only screen rejection. All survivors undergo exact membership; changing rank, zero/duplicate columns and multiple solutions are retained. The zero-only SIMD arm is a separate control. Every SAT model is checked on original equations; UNSAT requires completed retained search. FIBER_CAP is UNKNOWN.
selection: Three discovery probes use only n16/n24 seeds 17 and 937. They retain initial zero-row screening, exact redundant-row screening with small-column storage, and a compiler inlining comparison. The primary retains all 144 predecessor systems and adds 24 unused holdouts. Final timed mathematics uses the second probe version; forced inlining in probe03 did not improve the complete discovery grid consistently.
